_comment: COMPACTION, which is step one of two (#248). Powder metallurgy presses a powder into a fragile
green body and THEN sinters it; this is the press, and the Sintering Kiln is the firing.
Four, and the number is load-bearing rather than tuned. Vanilla crafts one blaze rod into TWO
blaze powder, and a cooking recipe consumes exactly one item - so anything that turned powder
into a rod one-for-one would hand back more than it took and multiply without limit. At four,
a rod costs four powder and melts back to two: a loss in both directions, and no loop.
A bench rather than a machine because pressing is the cheap half. The verb this feature adds is
sintering, and that is what the kiln does.
